title: Obtrusive
summary: OBTRU'SIVE, adjective Disposed to obtrude any thing upon others; inclined to intrude or thrust one's self among others, or to enter uninvited. Not obvious, not obtrusive but retired, the more desirabl

inlines.v: OBTRU'SIVE, adjective Disposed to obtrude any thing upon others; inclined to intrude or thrust one's self among others, or to enter uninvited. Not obvious, not obtrusive but retired, the more desirable.
